chunk_map.heading: # Sharpen the plan with two reads (lede)
Scan the plan before you push back
Phase 4: Walk down the unresolved branches
Answer the branches that change what "done" means
Switch to a picker if you prefer one
Stop when the plan is good enough to generate
Run the original grill-me if you want the full hour
Phase 5: Stop, then surface the patterns

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 3 "Scan the plan before you push back": line 36: "Scan it against the five things a good plan has" — never named or unpacked in this file, but resolves via the module-arc-beats/lecture-adjacency carve-out (rule 1): `plan-mode-done-right.md` includes `lectures/when-a-plan-is-good.md` (L32) immediately before this exercise (L34), and the maintainer block (L116) states the concept is deliberately taught only in that adjacent lecture. No other unresolved pronoun/demonstrative found across the 12 chunks under a sequential read — axis terms (Soft items/Assumptions/Alternatives, chunk 4), "unresolved branches" (chunk 5, self-named by its own header), and "the plan" (used throughout after being introduced at chunk 0) all resolve against prior slides of this same file.

No chunk points at another file by position. The one cross-file reference ("the five things a good plan has", chunk 3, line 36) names the claim, not a location, and the one external link (chunk 9, line 83, Pocock's grill-me) names the document in its own link text.
